findings.trigger: A successful display status response followed by a failed poll or failed mutation.
findings.symptom: Cached/optimistic display state was still presented as current and retained controls could write without a successful status refresh.
findings.evidence: New success-then-reject frontend regression failed before the fix.
findings.fix: Synchronous trusted-status admission gate; failed reads/writes block controls and show a retry state until confirmed recovery.
findings.regression: tests/frontend_async_polling.cjs success -> poll reject -> retained EDID callback -> retry recovery.
findings.impact: Truthful status and ownership admission without adding ordinary polling or hardware work.

findings.trigger: Hide/reopen a page, including a write pending across the visibility change.
findings.symptom: A retained toggle or the previous visit write reply could admit a new write before current display ownership was read.
findings.evidence: New pending write -> hide -> reopen -> old reply regression failed before visit revision handling.
findings.fix: Visibility and visit revision checks; ignore an old visit result and immediately queue one fresh verification read when its write finishes.
findings.regression: tests/frontend_async_polling.cjs hidden retained toggle, reopening before status, and in-flight previous visit write result.
findings.impact: Blocks stale actions, preserves accepted in-flight work and provides immediate recovery rather than waiting for the next polling tick.
